label: TP
reason: The code uses java.util.Random to generate a session key (rememberMeKey), which is cryptographically weak and constitutes a real vulnerability for sensitive data. Although an XSS finding is reported, tracing the data flow shows the cookie name and value are derived from server-side constants (class name, Random), meaning no user input reaches the sink, rendering the XSS finding a false positive.

evidence.note: Uses java.util.Random to generate rememberMeKey, which is insecure for session tokens.
